question: Show total payments for each customer
sql: SELECT customers.name, SUM(payments.amount) AS total_paid FROM customers JOIN orders ON orders.customer_id = customers.id JOIN payments ON payments.order_id = orders.id GROUP BY customers.name ORDER BY customers.name

question: List orders by customer
sql: SELECT customers.name, orders.id AS order_id FROM customers JOIN orders ON orders.customer_id = customers.id

question: Show product names and quantities for order 101
sql: SELECT products.name, order_items.quantity FROM order_items JOIN products ON order_items.product_id = products.id WHERE order_items.order_id = 101 ORDER BY products.name

question: Show latest audit log action for user admin
sql: SELECT audit_logs.action FROM audit_logs JOIN users ON audit_logs.user_id = users.id WHERE users.username = 'admin' ORDER BY audit_logs.timestamp DESC LIMIT 1

question: List open support tickets by customer
sql: SELECT customers.name, support_tickets.subject FROM support_tickets JOIN customers ON support_tickets.customer_id = customers.id WHERE support_tickets.status = 'open' ORDER BY customers.name, support_tickets.subject
